releases.name: v0.2.0: question and pending text colors
releases.body:
Your own messages can now have their own text color, and so can messages queued while the agent is still working, so it's easy to see what hasn't been sent yet. Both are in **Settings → Turn markers → Text** and default to the app's own colors.

This also fixes the color boxes on the settings page running past the card's edge, and adds screenshots and update instructions to the README.

**Update**

```sh
opencode plugin update github:sepatel/opencode-turn-markers
```

Then fully quit and reopen the Desktop app.

**Full changes:** https://github.com/sepatel/opencode-turn-markers/compare/87adde2...v0.2.0
